title: E-BERT: Efficient-Yet-Effective Entity Embeddings for BERT

bias_targets.target: Nationality and Language Bias (via Name Associations)
bias_targets.methodology: Using cloze-style questions (e.g., '[X] is a common name in the following language: [MASK]') to identify if the model relies on surface-level name associations rather than factual knowledge. The paper evaluates this by filtering out these overly helpful name priors to create a harder benchmark (LAMA-UHN) and measuring the performance drop.

primary_bias_target: Nationality and Language Bias (via Name Associations)
